downloaded_tex_candidate.title: Sejarah dan Perkembangan Teknik Natural Language Processing (NLP) Bahasa Indonesia: Tinjauan tentang sejarah, perkembangan teknologi, dan aplikasi NLP dalam bahasa Indonesia
downloaded_tex_candidate.author: Mukhlis Amien
downloaded_tex_candidate.reason: The body is genuinely Indonesian and the TeX was inspected directly, but its field is NLP rather than mathematical probability or statistics. It cannot justify B011 sampling terminology.

fallback_source.selection_reason: A 266-page Indonesian university probability textbook directly covers sampling with and without replacement, events, independence, probability, populations, and random variables.
fallback_source.title: Teori Peluang
fallback_source.publisher: Jurusan PMIPA FKIP Universitas Lambung Mangkurat
fallback_source.rights_note: The PDF states that copyright is reserved and reproduction requires permission apart from short research or review quotation. It is an internal terminology witness only and must not enter a public release payload.

comparisons.fallback_observation: The witness consistently uses sampel and describes taking elements; the established edition compound pengambilan sampel is already used throughout the sampling-design material.

comparisons.decision: retain and mark language-reviewed for B011
retain and mark language-reviewed for B011

comparisons.fallback_observation: The witness uses bebas/saling bebas for events on PDF page 32 and independen for random variables on PDF page 142.
comparisons.decision: Retain saling independen for edition consistency and the random-observation context; preserve saling bebas as a valid glossary synonym.

comparisons.fallback_observation: The witness presents Probabilitas/Peluang as a paired heading and uses peluang for individual event questions.
comparisons.decision: retain the edition rule: peluang for individual events; probabilitas only in established compounds

comparisons.fallback_observation: The witness also uses saling terpisah; the edition already controls saling lepas.
comparisons.decision: retain saling lepas for consistency and mathematical precision

decision.glossary_refinement: Add B011 terms dengan pengembalian and tanpa pengembalian as language-reviewed, and retain saling bebas as an accepted synonym of saling independen.
decision.propagation: No translated prose requires replacement. The B011 backend must bind this receipt and emit the two replacement terms with language-reviewed status.
decision.reason: The candidate terms match the representative field witness. The witness's bebas/independen split supports recording a synonym, not destabilizing the established edition term.

edition_provenance.credit_rule: Preserve David M. Diez, Mine Çetinkaya-Rundel, Christopher D. Barr, all upstream/component authors, and any human contributor credits. Model identification does not replace those credits.

public_payload_rule: Publish the QA receipt and decisions if useful, but do not redistribute the copyrighted fallback PDF, extracted text, or rendered pages.
